have.what_it_gives: request_type sales_push, diagnostic across 4 lines (digital pianos, beginner electric guitars + amps, ukuleles, «Распродажа»). Targets: 6/12/20 orders and 25/50/80 coded chats by 2026-11-15. Baseline = week-0 count (2026-10-12…18), with targets re-fixed on 2026-11-01. Constraints: hands, instruments and voice only until consent; site prices ≤7 days old; no new offer; no «Финальная» or sale reason or date; don't repeat «100% оригинальный»; don't promote the review-for-refund clause. 3 clarifying questions already queued.

47 usable facts. Contacts: WhatsApp +7 701 0987734, city phone, mobile, address ул. Кажымукана 14 НП-6, call hours пн–пт 10–19 / сб 10–17. Returns: 14 days, conditions, delivery both ways withheld (+3% for cash on delivery). Warranty: at least 12 months; Casio 2 years, service in Almaty only. Delivery: free across KZ over 100 000 ₸; Astana courier free over 20 kg and over 15 000 ₸; pickup reserve 3 working days. Payments: Kaspi QR/Pay/transfer, Visa/MC, Apple Pay, cash. Dated prices for 8 SKUs: Hibilly Retro 30R 56 576 ₸ (was 70 720), Mapex Comet 283 296 ₸ (was 354 120), Alston AS-100BK 59 800 ₸, Caesar U-246 22 100 ₸, Caesar US-C40 32 901 ₸, Alston UF-330 64 501 ₸, Casio PX-770 521 935 ₸ (3 in stock), Casio AP-270 734 886 ₸ (5 in stock), with specs. Expiry: 2026-10-08 prices on 2026-10-15; piano prices (2026-10-09) on 2026-10-16. Stock flags expire 48 h after fetch. Not usable: px770_price, px770_instock, ap270_price, ap270_instock, diff_pno. Derived ids without source or date: hib_disc, mapex_disc, diff_uke.

6 catalogue lists. The «Распродажа» list has 535 items with price, old_price and discount_pct (e.g. Gretsch Electromatic Jet 378 144 ₸ from 472 680 ₸, −20%; Blackstar HTV-212 MK III 180 180 ₸ from 257 400 ₸, −30%). Gives catalogue depth per line for picking test SKUs and budget_ladder candidates.

135 product records with availability and stock_qty (e.g. Zildjian 19" K Sweet Crash: 1 unit; Hercules MS434B stand: 51 units). Shows which sale and featured SKUs are thin (1 unit, so no conversion push without a same-day re-check) and which can carry a series. Expires 48 h after fetch.

12 detailed product records with specs and availability (e.g. Cort X100 OPBK 98 280 ₸, OutOfStock; 24 frets, HH pickups, meranti body). Spec material for who_is_it_for and ab_compare ideas. OutOfStock items are excluded from conversion ideas.

Own YouTube: 3 620 subscribers, 379 videos, median 2 300 views (mostly long-form), best 64 000 (beginner electric guitar demo), last upload 2026-05-10. Content mix includes sound demos, model comparisons (e.g. 3 Fender Stratocasters) and artist interviews. The newest entries (pos 0–7 checked) have views = null, so the last-15 baseline cannot be computed from this file yet. These uploads are a zero-staff-minute footage library for re-cuts.

13 RU/UA-language YouTube peer channels: 6 retail, 4 review, 3 lessons. Followers 3 540–197 000; channel medians 762–23 500 views. Channel level only: no post-level outliers, no Shorts or Reels mechanisms, and no peer confirmed as based in Kazakhstan.

Text judge ≈ chance on Shorts (ρ 0.11, retail 0.07). Long-form title tricks don't transfer (L003). Search-first plain model-name titles work on long-form YouTube (L002, L004). No price slides (L005). Brand-only cymbal and drum demos had a 390-view median vs 2 300 (n=48), and interviews 118 (n=4), so demos must answer a buyer question (L006).
